events.text:
T-242 is done. My earlier "red probes match the baseline" line was wrong and is corrected, the three probes that got worse are now noted on T-424, and the log update is pushed to main (1ed96c76, no force).

The export-site log from the chain-1557 run is empty (0 bytes), so I can't prove the cause; this is the most likely one. The build died after 8s at 12:32. The shared `.export-scratch` folder was then rebuilt by a different export that finished at 12:33:39. The empty log is because `stage_site` in `app/scripts/run-chain.sh` keeps only the last output line of `export-static.sh`, which throws away the build error.
